//MU310 指令可以自行修改   LOVE JOVIAN


==MU310 1.1.0.0.1A==
1.  MFG mode set = fw_setenv mfg 1
2.  MFG mode get = fw_printenv -n mfg
3.  Factory Reset reboot = pega_factory_default
4.  Factory Reset no重啟 = pega_factory_default -n
5.  SW ver get = uci -P /var/state get pega.fw.cur_ver
6.  HW ver set = fw_setenv hwver ER_JOVIAN
7.  HW ver get = fw_printenv -n hwver
8.  Modem FW version get = atcli at+cgmr
9.  Model Name set = fw_setenv pega_model MU310
10. Model Name get = fw_printenv -n pega_model
11. Unit SN set = fw_setenv sn A12345
12. Unit SN get = fw_printenv -n sn
13. MB SN set = fw_setenv mb_sn B12345
14. MB SN get = fw_printenv -n mb_sn
15. UUID set = fw_setenv uuid uuid12345
16. UUID get = fw_printenv -n uuid
17. 5G LED Red On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_weak
18. 5G LED Green On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_strong
19. 5G LED Blue On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_moderate
20. 5G LED Off set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_off
21. Status LED Red On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest status_red
22. Status LED Green On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest status_green
23. Status LED Blue On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest status_amber
24. Status LED Off set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest status_off
25. All LED On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest allledon
26. All LED Off set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest allledoff
27. Reset button status get = /etc/diag.sh resetBtnStatusGet
28. SIM detect CCID/CIMI= atcli at+cpin?==>atcli at+ccid==>atcli at+cimi
29. SIM實體=atcli 'AT+QUIMSLOT=1'==>atcli 'AT+QUIMSLOT?'==>atcli 'AT+CPIN?'==>atcli 'AT+CREG?'==>atcli 'AT+COPS?'
30. ESIM=atcli 'AT+QUIMSLOT=2'==>atcli 'AT+QUIMSLOT?'==>atcli 'AT+QESIM="lpa_enable",1'==>DELAY:3==>atcli 'AT+QESIM="eid"'==>atcli 'AT+QESIM="profile_brief"'
31. SIM IMSI get = atcli at+cimi
32. Modem IMEI get = atcli at+gsn
33. MAC address set /get= fw_setenv eth0_addr 11:22:33:44:55:66==>fw_printenv -n eth0_addr
34. 5G On set = atcli at+cfun=1
35. 5G Off set = atcli at+cfun=0
36. 5G status get = atcli at+cfun?
37. 5G module Thermal get = atcli 'AT+QTHERMAL="thermal_level"'
38. USB function set enable= atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg",0x2C7C,0x0801,2,1,1,0,0,1,0'
39. USB function get enable= atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg"'
40. USB function disabled set = atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg",0x2C7C,0x0801,2,1,0,0,0,0,0'
41. USB function get enable= atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg"'
42. IMS disable set = atcli 'AT+QCFG="ims",2'
43. IMS status get = atcli 'AT+QCFG="ims"'





==MU310 整理B==
1.  build time=cat /etc/pega_fwinfo==>uci -P /var/state get pega.led.booting_state
2.  EXIT=exit
3.  Login=exit==>root==>oelinux123==>cat /etc/pega_fwinfo
4.  pega_model set/get=fw_setenv pega_model MU310==>fw_printenv -n pega_model
5.  MFG mode set/get = fw_setenv mfg 1==>fw_printenv -n mfg
6.  Factory Reset reboot = pega_factory_default
7.  SW/HW ver get = uci -P /var/state get pega.fw.cur_ver==> fw_setenv hwver ER_JOVIAN==>fw_printenv -n hwver
8.  Modem FW version get = atcli at+cgmr
9.  Model Name set/get = fw_setenv pega_model MU310==> fw_printenv -n pega_model
10. Unit SN set/get = fw_setenv sn A12345==>fw_printenv -n sn
11. MB SN set/get = fw_setenv mb_sn B12345==>fw_printenv -n mb_sn
12. UUID set/get = fw_setenv uuid uuid12345==>fw_printenv -n uuid
13. All LED On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest allledon
14. All LED Off set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest allledoff
15. 5G LED On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest status_off==>/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_weak==>/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_strong==>/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_moderate
16. Status LED On set = /etc/diag.sh ledtest status_off==>/etc/diag.sh ledtest status_red==>/etc/diag.sh ledtest status_green==>/etc/diag.sh ledtest status_amber
17. Reset button status get = /etc/diag.sh resetBtnStatusGet
18. SIM Get 實體SIM_IMSI/CCID=atcli 'AT+QUIMSLOT=1'==>atcli at+cimi==>atcli 'AT+CCID'
19. SIM Get ESIM_IMEI/EID/QCCID=atcli 'AT+QUIMSLOT=2'==>atcli 'AT+QESIM="lpa_enable",1'==>atcli at+gsn==>atcli 'AT+QESIM="eid"'==>atcli 'AT+QCCID'==>atcli 'AT+QESIM="profile_brief"'
20. MAC address set /get= fw_setenv eth0_addr 11:22:33:44:55:66==>fw_printenv -n eth0_addr
21. 5G On set = atcli at+cfun=1
22. 5G Off set = atcli at+cfun=0
23. 5G status get = atcli at+cfun?
24. 5G module Thermal get = atcli 'AT+QTHERMAL="thermal_level"'

25. USB function set enable= atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg",0x2C7C,0x0801,2,1,1,0,0,1,0'==>reboot
26. USB function get USBCFG= atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg"'
27. USB function disabled set = atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg",0x2C7C,0x0801,2,1,0,0,0,0,0'==>reboot
29. IMS disable set = atcli 'AT+QCFG="ims",2'
30. IMS status get = atcli 'AT+QCFG="ims"'
31. close ADB LIST=atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg",0x2C7C,0x0801,1,1,1,1,1,1,0'==>reboot
	







//指令可以自行修改

MU310指令通_V1.1
